author: GamingBolt
description:
WILL: Follow the Light is able to accomplish a rare feat for a “walking simulator”: it is able to remain interesting throughout its entire runtime. Many other games in the genre often start falling apart after exploring one or two interesting ideas, but the central narrative here was enough to keep me going throughout my time with it. 

Paired with gorgeous visuals, strong voice acting, and even some fun gameplay mechanics thrown in to shake things up every now and then, WILL: Follow the Light is an easy game to recommend to those who prefer more meat on the bone when it comes to video game stories.
title: WILL: Follow the Light Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
It might be nearly a decade since we first laid hands on this one, but Uncharted 4 continues to be a title that has managed to stay quite relevant in any conversation about the finest blockbuster action-adventure games ever made. It presents a rollercoaster of a main campaign very well, pacing all of its set pieces, quiet moments, and combat encounters in a way that underlines a refined approach to the entire title.

Naughty Dog has cooked well enough for this one to be a very tempting offering even today, and we like to give credit where it’s due. Join us as we explore why Uncharted 4 continues to be a spellbinding adventure that holds up against some of modern gaming’s heavy hitters.
title: Why Uncharted 4 Still Feels Like a Modern Blockbuster 10 Years Later

author: GamingBolt
description:
The most ambitious open worlds are defined by more than just waypoints and checklists. For modern titles, a large map isn’t their primary draw either. The most rewarding open world games, instead, bring complexity and depth, whether that’s through interlocking systems, realistic mechanics, dynamic environmental events, or a combination. 

The absolute best showcase how their systemic web presents emergent moments too, where systems collide to yield unexpected or unpredictable gameplay. The ten titles in this rundown represent this complexity in their own ways, proving that depth wins over scale.
title: 10 Most Complex Open World Games That Are ABSOLUTELY Worth Mastering
